issue.positionEn: Read an object through the way it was used, then follow who can encounter and use it as it moves somewhere new.
issue.introEn: A set of Egyptian gold rings displayed on a modern wig helps recover the way the jewelry was worn. That relationship between form and use carries through this issue: from workwear in a skate shop to an outdoor sole on the street and a former religious compound reopened to the city. The listening radar adds two records released on November 20.
issue.closingEn: Shanghai’s jewelry exhibition runs until May. Révélations China closes on November 23. With one day to spare this week, start with the craft biennial and come back to the museum for a longer look at the wig rings and belt ornaments.
